title: Geometric nonlinear and arc-length review
policy: This contract defines the evidence required for Step 2. It does not close the gate or promote a capability.

total_lagrangian_elasticity.claim_boundary: bounded tested domain only; no universal large-deformation claim

arc_length.claim_boundary: controlled internal branch evidence; not production qualification

requirements.metric: relative difference against the existing linear solution at a documented small-strain load

threshold.source: TOL-026-NONLINEAR-001 is case-defined and has no numeric value

requirements.evidence: case result, comparison metric, configuration and digest

requirements.metric: spurious strain, stress, internal force and energy under rigid translation/rotation
requirements.evidence: translation, rotation and combined-motion result records

requirements.metric: load-displacement, rotation, det(F), residual and Newton history within the declared domain
relative residual, reaction balance and accepted Newton increments
requirements.evidence: residual history, reactions and convergence reason

requirements.metric: finite-difference comparison of element internal force and tangent
requirements.evidence: perturbation size, norm, error and tangent record

requirements.metric: successive change in declared observables across coarse, medium, fine and refined compatible meshes
requirements.evidence: mesh descriptors, DOF, curves, observable differences and limitation

requirements.metric: same physical load history compared across documented increment partitions and repeated runs

threshold.source: No G07-specific increment or reproducibility band exists

requirements.evidence: input digest, source SHA, environment, partition, output digest and dirty=false

requirements.metric: documented comparison of complete compatible response histories

threshold.source: Oracle-specific; no new threshold is approved here

requirements.evidence: source, assumptions, deck, metrics, error, tool version and digest

requirements.metric: load factor versus controlled displacement, branch direction and turning point
requirements.evidence: complete branch, turning-point diagnostics and residual history

requirements.metric: branch and turning-point changes under documented arc-step and mesh levels
requirements.evidence: radius, step count, mesh, branch curves and limitation

requirements.metric: state equality at checkpoint, correct rollback and deterministic retry outcome
requirements.evidence: checkpoint digest, failure classification, rollback record and retry history

requirements.metric: independent reproducible reference comparison when formulation-compatible

threshold.source: Absence or non-comparability is recorded as SKIPPED, never PASS

requirements.evidence: reference provenance and explicit research-only limitation

threshold_governance.rule: No null policy may be converted into a numerical pass band by the runner.

gate_boundary.gate_closure: not permitted by this contract alone
